content: ⌊ DRAFT g The Os High Proxy shall provide the following APIs for the Applicative Software Cluster : • GetResource • ReleaseResource • SuspendOSInterrupts • ResumeOSInterrupts • GetSpinlock • ReleaseSpinlock • GetApplicationID Each of these APIs corresponds to a service resource in the Os Low Proxy. There will be an entry in the Binary Manifest , to require these service resources, which are described here: SwCluCOsProxy .
